title: Gormiti: The Lords of Nature - Wii Standard Edition: Wii: Video Games - Amazon.ca
snippet: Gormiti: The Lords of Nature! features characters and locations from the popular Gormiti TV show co-produced by Marathon Media & Giochi Preziosi. The action starts as a character named Razzle, while cleaning the library, accidentally knocks some old books into a Portal.

title: Gormiti: The Lords of Nature (Nintendo DS, 2010) | Compra online en eBay
snippet: Players take the roles of the young human characters Nick, Lucas, Toby, and Jessica, most often in the forms of their Gormiti alter egos.<br><br>To move through each area, the Gormiti heroes must use their special abilities to overcome obstacles, such as raising water levels, punching through a barrier of boulders, swinging across caverns, or lifting objects with a gust of wind. Combat is also a major element of play, with regular battles against outnumbering forces of Magmion's minions. Between the action sequences, the story moves forward through computer-animated cut-scenes. ... Game NameGormiti: the Lords of Nature!
